title: Implement BFS, shortest path, and connected components in Python
description: Build graph.py with three algorithms: BFS traversal, unweighted shortest path (BFS-based), and connected components detection. A failing test suite is provided.

injections.content:
[project]
name = "python-graph"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

from graph import Graph


def make_graph() -> Graph:
    """  0 - 1 - 2
              |
              3 - 4   5 (isolated)
    """
    g = Graph()
    for v in range(6):
        g.add_vertex(v)
    g.add_edge(0, 1)
    g.add_edge(1, 2)
    g.add_edge(1, 3)
    g.add_edge(3, 4)
    return g


def test_bfs_from_zero():
    g = make_graph()
    visited = g.bfs(0)
    assert set(visited) == {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}
    assert visited[0] == 0  # start vertex is first


def test_bfs_from_isolated():
    g = make_graph()
    visited = g.bfs(5)
    assert visited == [5]


def test_shortest_path_direct():
    g = make_graph()
    path = g.shortest_path(0, 2)
    assert path == [0, 1, 2]


def test_shortest_path_longer():
    g = make_graph()
    path = g.shortest_path(0, 4)
    assert path == [0, 1, 3, 4]


def test_shortest_path_unreachable():
    g = make_graph()
    path = g.shortest_path(0, 5)
    assert path is None


def test_shortest_path_same_vertex():
    g = make_graph()
    assert g.shortest_path(2, 2) == [2]


def test_connected_components():
    g = make_graph()
    comps = g.connected_components()
    assert len(comps) == 2
    component_sets = [frozenset(c) for c in comps]
    assert frozenset({0, 1, 2, 3, 4}) in component_sets
    assert frozenset({5}) in component_sets


def test_connected_components_empty():
    g = Graph()
    assert g.connected_components() == []

task_spec.prompt:
Create src/graph.py implementing a Graph class for undirected graphs.

The Graph class must support:
  add_vertex(v: int) -> None        — register a vertex (no-op if already present)
  add_edge(u: int, v: int) -> None  — add undirected edge between u and v
  bfs(start: int) -> list[int]      — BFS traversal from start; return vertices in visit order
  shortest_path(src: int, dst: int) -> list[int] | None
                                    — shortest (fewest hops) path from src to dst;
                                       return [src] if src==dst; None if unreachable
  connected_components() -> list[list[int]]
                                    — return list of components (each a list of vertex IDs);
                                       order within each component and order of components don't matter;
                                       return [] for an empty graph

All 8 tests in tests/test_graph.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: bfs returns vertices in BFS order
shortest_path uses BFS for minimum hops
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (8 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
